name: edgedesk-sports
description: EdgeDesk Sports — a static research terminal, the deterministic football and UFC pipelines that feed it, and the public article system that publishes what they find. No dependencies: every script here runs on a bare Node install, and the browser reads committed artifacts rather than computing anything.
